name: Richtersveld Cultural and Botanical Landscape
description: In the far north-west corner of South Africa, the Richtersveld is a rugged desert of volcanic peaks, sandy plains and deep gorges, bordered by the green ribbon of the Orange River. Nama herders still move their livestock here with the seasons, and it is the only place where they build portable rush-mat houses. The land is communally managed and sits in an arid biodiversity hotspot.
